facts.business: Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation Limited (GMDC) is a mining PSU engaged in lignite, coal, bauxite, limestone, renewable energy, and strategic minerals like rare earth elements and copper, along with Underground Coal Gasification projects.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Reports do not contain any qualification, reservation, adverse remark, or disclaimer requiring any explanation from the Board.

key_risks: Project execution delays due to land acquisition, statutory and environmental approvals, infrastructure creation, rehabilitation planning and stakeholder coordination
Operational continuity impacted by extended monsoon conditions and waterlogging at mining locations
Market dynamics including changes in fuel economics, competition from imported materials
facts.related_party_note: Members may refer to Note 2.48 of the Standalone Financial Statement which sets out Related Parties Disclosures pursuant to Ind AS 24.
